question: For the completed-U1 finite-k scalar system, does super-horizon regularity uniquely determine the Newtonian/Stueckelberg preferred-foliation variable chi=B, or is the apparent chi initial datum generated by transforming an algebraic preferred-coordinate DAE into Newtonian source variables?

scope.background: flat FLRW with total background conservation rho_total_prime=-3 H (rho_total+p_total)
scope.modes: finite scalar Fourier k>0; exact k=0 excluded and routed to the homogeneous bridge
scope.completion_domain: lambda_HL>1, E_th>0, finite M_c>0, ordinary H0_prime nonzero
scope.source_units: native CLASS hatted stresses, rho_hat=(8 pi G/3)rho_phys
scope.gauge_bridge: quasilongitudinal preferred coordinates E=delta_varphi=0 and the already-certified Newtonian/Stueckelberg map chi_N=B

acceptance: derive exactly, after total background conservation and D=3lambda_HL-1=2+3r, R_reg=-r C_reg with C_reg=3a^2 delta_mu_N+9Ha q_N+2HL chi-3a^2 Pcal a1_eff(deltaH0_N-H0_prime chi)
show that for finite M_c, a1_eff=k^2/(k^2+a^2 M_c^2)=O(k^2) and L=-k^2, hence every explicit chi contribution to C_reg is O(k^2)
therefore prove that the leading physical super-horizon condition 3a^2 delta_mu_N+9Ha q_N=O(k^2) makes phi finite for every finite chi and does not by itself select a unique chi_initial

reconstruct the preferred-coordinate solve ordering without Newtonian source elimination: A constraint fixes psi and psi_prime from deltaH0_pref and its derivative; the Hamiltonian constraint fixes phi through -(r E_th k^2+2D H^2); the momentum constraint then fixes B algebraically through r L B=Mq_pref-D(psi_prime+H phi)
prove all three preferred-coordinate denominators are nonzero on the stated finite-k domain, so B needs no independent temporal initial datum in that representation

show explicitly that substituting deltaH0_pref=deltaH0_N-H0_prime chi into the differentiated A constraint introduces -K H0_prime chi_prime; the first-order chi equation of shadow-v3 is therefore produced by coordinate/source elimination
do not promote the Newtonian detached first-order integration constant to an extra propagating scalar degree of freedom; keep the actual coupled initial projection as a separate next gate
machine-check all exact symbolic identities with zero residual and emit an immutable JSON certificate
next_if_pass: Freeze a preferred-coordinate adiabatic seed/projection gate that derives the finite-k B seed from a self-consistent early-time matter series, then transform that projected state to the Newtonian Boltzmann interface; do not set chi=0 by convenience.
non_claims: does not yet provide the numerical or analytic value of chi_initial for the physical adiabatic branch
does not prove uniqueness of the complete early-time adiabatic series
does not implement completed-U1 metric feedback in CLASS
does not select M_c or lambda_HL numerically
does not change any historical likelihood result
